talk_wizard_1:
Lumela monna wa me!
O etsa eng fa?
talk_player_1:
Lumela!
O tumeletswa go thusa bana ba basitsweng ke diphoofolo tse di dulang tsebeletsenyeng eno.
talk_wizard_2:
Xa...
Ga ke sa go tshenyege, fela o ngwanesha ya boraro e tumeletsweng go dira molao. Go fihla jaanong, ga go na sepe se dumelang, le malapa a bona a timela go dilamorago.
talk_player_2:
O se tlhake. Motho wa bongwanesha o sa tshwanelang le fa o be o tshela!
Ke tla tlosa diphoofolo tsotlhe tse di dulang mona ke thusa bana!
talk_wizard_3:
Ee, go thabile go gaufinyana o sa tlhake! Fela o se ke wa bua gore ga ke go tlhokomolositse!
Lokologa!
talk_boss_1:
Tima leleme, diphoofolo tse di swanesang!
Nako e fihlile ya go ja diperese tsa hao! ha ha ha ha
talk_player_3:
Ga se diphoofolo tsa hao tse di swanesang tseo!
Matsatsi a hao a di swanesang a fetsile!
talk_boss_2:
Sheba! Motho mokgatlho o mogolo o tlhophilang go ma ka fa!
Ha ha ha ha
Tla mona!
talk_kid_2:
Ke leboha ditlhore!
O kgonile go fokotsa diphoofolo tse di swanesang! Ke leboha thata!
Ga ke tsebe gore ke go leboga jang!
talk_player_4: Ke hona go thusa o ka kgona! Fela se tshabe ka tshia, tata wa hao o ntlhetswe mothusi wa bongothoko go thusa o! :-)
